subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about winning back lapsed and cancelled paid subscribers for {Brand}, the way we have for standalone utilities like Notion and Grammarly. The one point worth repeating: we optimize to the validated resubscribe, reading the leak between activation drop-off and the resumed paid subscription so the spend lands on real renewals. In practice that runs around a 38% trial-to-paid signal on the recovered pool. Happy to send the activation-to-renewal recovery view for your lapsed base. Worth a quick look?
illustrative_flags: trial-to-paid signal of 38% on the recovered pool (MobUpps-specific quality signal; illustrative, calibrated to the productivity trial-to-paid band)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN utility_and_productivity retargeting: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof (optimize to validated resubscribe, reads activation-to-resubscribe leak); one illustrative MobUpps figure (38% trial-to-paid signal) flagged; reuses parent brands Notion + Grammarly only; soft CTA, 1 question mark; no sign-off; native US B2B register; no em-dash, no X-not-Y.
